highlights.title: Settings, reorganized
highlights.body: Settings opens larger, with General, Claude Code, Updates and About panes. Add or revoke project folders right in its Claude Code pane.

highlights.title: See every MCP server in one place
highlights.body: A new MCP section lists every server Claude Code can use, from your config, plugins, and claude.ai, with its tool calls, failures, and config problems.

highlights.title: Track MCP calls in Usage
highlights.body: Usage has an MCP servers panel: calls over time, the busiest servers, how often each one fails, and how much its results add to your context.

highlights.title: Remove MCP servers and sign out
highlights.body: From an MCP server's details, remove a declaration, log out of a remote server, or reset a project's .mcp.json approvals, all through Claude Code's CLI.

highlights.title: Explore token usage by hour or day
highlights.body: Click a token chart bar to see its input, output, cache reads and writes, plus model and project breakdowns.

highlights.title: Read Claude Code from any folder
highlights.body: Megatron now follows CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and Settings lets you choose the Claude Code folder yourself, with your profile folders suggested.

highlights.title: Skills installed as links now appear
highlights.body: Skills that Orca or npx skills link into ~/.claude/skills are now listed, and a linked skill's details show the folder it really lives in.
